peft.standalone: Iyi LoRA / PEFT adapta inoda yakazara base modhi. Ngenisa base uye batanidza adapta mu Safetensors inopa; saizi yeadapter chete haisiriyo ndangariro inodiwa kuimhanyisa.
peft.description: Sarudza iyo yakazara base modhi pamusoro, wozotevera iyo adapta folda. Adapter chete haisi muenzaniso wakakwana. Base identity inofanirwa kuenderana neadapter kumisikidza.
peft.estimate: Conservative CPU fungidziro pa2,048 tokeni. Yakaverengerwazve mudziyo wakasarudzwa uye mamiriro panguva yekurodha. Target modules uye tensor maumbirwo anotariswa panguva yekurodha.

limitedSupport: Mupi uyu anogona kunge asiri kutsigirwa zvizere. Kugona (zvishandiso, chiono, odhiyo) haaonekwe otomatiki - wedzera mamodhi nemaoko uye gadzirisa kugona pa modhi.
mlxExperimental: MLX tsigiro ndeyekuedza. Zvekumisikidza hazviwanikwe, gadziriso yekufunga haisati yaiswa waya, uye mamwe mavakirwo emhando nyowani anogona kutadza kurodha. Mhan'ara nyaya paGitHub kuti tizviise pamberi.
engineBundled: Injini yekufungidzira yakavakirwa mu Novera, saka hapana chekudhawunirodha kana kugadzirisa zvakasiyana. Taura iyi vhezheni paunoshuma modhi inotadza kurodha.
engineOtherVersion: Unoda imwe llama.cpp vhezheni? Mhanya yako llama-server woiwedzera setsika OpenAI-inofambirana nayo.
refreshModelsError: Mutengesi anofanirwa kunge aine base URL uye kamwechete API kiyi akagadzirirwa kutora modhi.
noNewModels: Hapana mhando nyowani dzawanikwa. Mhando dzese dziripo dzakatowedzerwa.
refreshModelsFailed: Tatadza kutora mhando kubva ku{{provider}}. Tapota tarisa API kiyi yako nebasi URL.
embeddingModelsDesc: Inoshandiswa ku RAG uye kutsvaga kwevector. Iyo yakasarudzwa modhi inova yekusarudzika kana ichigadzira embeddings.
importedTooltip: Yakatorwa kubva kufaira renzvimbo. Kuibvisa kubva Novera hakuzodzime faira iri padhisiki.
noModelFoundDesc: Mamodheru aripo achanyorwa pano. Kana usati wava nemamodheru, shanyira Hub kuti utore.
noModelFoundRemoteDesc: Mamodheru aripo achanyorwa pano. Shandisa bhatani rekuvandudza riri pamusoro kuti utore mhando kubva kune anopa, kana kuwedzera imwe nemaoko ne + bhatani.

deleteModel.choiceDescription: Sarudza nzira yekubvisa modhi iyi kubva kuNovera.
deleteModel.keepFilesDescription: Bvisa modhi kubva pane rondedzero uye chengeta mafaera ayo ari padhisiki. Unogona kuunza kunze zvakare.
deleteModel.permanentDescription: Bvisa modhi uye Novera-mafaira akabatwa kubva kudhisiki. Izvi hazvigone kugadziriswa.
deleteModel.permanentImportedDescription: Dzima zvakare hombe GGUF faira panzvimbo yarachiri. Mafaira ekunze ekubatsira anochengetwa. Izvi hazvigone kugadziriswa.
deleteModel.removedSuccess: Model {{modelId}} yakabviswa mu Novera. Mafaira ayo akachengetwa.
deleteModel.title: Dzima iyi modhi: {{modelId}}
deleteModel.description: Une chokwadi chekuti unoda kudzima modhi iyi? Chiito ichi hachigone kuregererwa.
deleteModel.importedDescription: Bvisa modhi iyi yatorwa kubva kunze kwenyika kubva kuNovera? Faera rako remunharaunda padhisiki harizodzimwa.

deleteAllModels.title: Kudzima mhando dzese dzakadhawunirodha?
deleteAllModels.importedExcluded: {{count}} modhi (ma) ekunze achachengetwa (mafaira avo haana kudhaunirodwa neNovera).
deleteAllModels.partialFailure: Yatadza kudzima {{count}} modhi(s). Ona console kuti uwane ruzivo.

deleteProvider.title: Dzima mupi uyu
deleteProvider.description: Bvisa mupi uyu nemhando dzayo dzese. Chiito ichi hachigone kuregererwa.
deleteProvider.confirmDescription: Une chokwadi chekuti unoda kudzima mupi uyu? Chiito ichi hachigone kuregererwa.

editModel.title: Rongedza Model: {{modelId}}
editModel.description: Gadzirisa maitiro emodhi nekushandura sarudzo dziri pazasi.

warning.title: Ramba uchichenjerera
warning.description: Kugadzirisa modhi kugona kunogona kukanganisa kuita uye kushanda. Zvisizvo zvigadziriso zvinogona kukonzera maitiro asina kutarisirwa kana kukanganisa.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: Yako Azure OpenAI yekupedzisira. Tsiva YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME nezita rako rekushandisa reAzure.
baseUrl.alibabaDescription: Shandisa iyo yekupedzisira yeAlibaba Cloud nzvimbo yekushandira uye dunhu. Tsiva YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID nenzvimbo yako yekushandira ID uye shandisa kiyi yeAPI kubva munharaunda imwe cheteyo.

apiKeys.title: API makiyi
apiKeys.description: Isa kiyi yako yeAPI. Unogona kuwedzera mamwe makiyi muAdvanced, uye Novera ichaedza inotevera otomatiki kana kiyi yatadza.
apiKeys.testHint: Inotarisa /models nekiyi yega yega uye inoratidza chimiro chekiyi.
